label: MEASURED (this run; tool)

variants.name: plain
variants.description: project flow (scripts/synth.sh plain): map each module with abc, THEN flatten, no opt_merge
variants.script:
read_verilog design.v
hierarchy -top v2
proc
opt_clean
techmap
opt_clean
abc -g AND,OR,XOR,MUX
opt_clean
setattr -mod -unset keep_hierarchy *
flatten
opt_clean
techmap
opt_clean
write_json netlist.json
variants.yosys_command: yosys -q -s flow.ys  (run in a directory holding design.v)

summary.line: verdict changes across 8 variants: min flips ranged 1..3 (at max_flips=3: ATTACK_FOUND in 8, NO_ATTACK_UP_TO_BOUND in 0)

note: one row = one synthesis flow = one netlist hash; cost = minimum number of flips found (exact when no '<='), '>k' = none within <= k flips and the cycle bound, 'unknown' = solver timeout (NOT 'no attack'), 'unsupported' = the engine cannot read that netlist (no verdict), 'synth-failed' = Yosys error. bounded result under this model; not a proof of security. Faults are modelled bit flips; the variants are a small sample of synthesis choices, not all of them.
